items.p: कोयला मंत्रालय के सचिव विक्रम देव दत्त ने बताया कि कोयला गैसीकरण परियोजनाओं से भारत 5-7 साल में 1.5 लाख करोड़ रुपये की विदेशी मुद्रा बचा सकता है। केंद्र ने 46,000 करोड़ रुपये के प्रोत्साहन दिए हैं।

items.h: 'यह एक अद्भुत नई दुनिया है': AI पर रोक की मांग पर एलन मस्क का तंज, स्पेस में डेटा सेंटर को लेकर क्या?
items.p:
एलन मस्क ने एआई पर रोक की मांग पर तंज कसते हुए AI को अद्भुत नई दुनिया बताया है।
डेमोक्रेट सांसद यास्मीन अंसारी ने एडवांस्ड एआई पर रोक और सुपरइंटेलिजेंस पर बैन की मांग की थी।
'स्पेस में डेटा सेंटर' को लेकर भी मस्क ने पोस्ट किया है।

items.h: द बोनस मार्केट अपडेट: यूएस मिडटर्म चुनाव नतीजों से बाजार में बहार, सेंसेक्स 2100 अंक उछला, जानें निफ्टी का हाल
items.p: अमेरिकी मध्यावधि चुनावों में डेमोक्रेटिक पार्टी की जीत के बाद वैश्विक बाजारों में तेजी आई। कच्चे तेल की कीमतें दो महीने के निचले स्तर पर पहुंचने से सेंसेक्स और निफ्टी में जोरदार उछाल दर्ज किया गया। जानें क्या रहे प्रमुख कारण।

items.p: टाटा संस के चेयरमैन एन चंद्रशेखरन ने रोम में इटली की प्रधानमंत्री जॉर्जिया मेलोनी से मुलाकात कर इवेको अधिग्रहण के बाद की रणनीति साझा की। 2.28 लाख करोड़ रुपये के संयुक्त राजस्व और वैश्विक विस्तार की पूरी रिपोर्ट पढ़ें।

items.h: India lifted 49.6 crore people out of poverty between 2011 and 2023, says World Bank report - Here is how it was done
items.p: The World Bank says India lifted an estimated 496 million people out of poverty between 2011 and 2023. Extreme poverty fell from 27.1% to 2.6%, driven by consumption growth, rising employment—particularly among women—and expanded social transfers.

items.h: Zomato launches limitless delivery; how the new service works and what it offers — check details here
items.p: Zomato has launched Limitless Delivery feature in seven Indian cities, allowing customers to order from restaurants up to 40 km away. Details here.

items.h: Madhavan Hariharan to take over as Birlasoft CEO
items.p: Less than an hour after Birlasoft announced the exit of CEO Angan Guha, Wipro announced his appointment as the head of one of its largest business lines, Americas 2.

items.h: Tata Power commissions 300 MW solar project in Karnataka, to cut 1 lakh tonnes of carbon emissions yearly
items.p: Once operational, the solar project is expected to produce 810 million units (MUs) of renewable electricity annually. It is also estimated to prevent around 103,820 tonnes of carbon emissions every year.

items.h: China blocks SoftBank’s $5.4 billion ABB robotics deal: How Beijing is tightening its grip on strategic technologies
items.p: China has blocked SoftBank’s $5.4 billion acquisition of ABB’s robotics business, citing concerns over strategic technology and data security. The move follows Beijing’s decision to unwind Meta’s $2 billion-plus acquisition of AI startup Manus, signalling tighter scrutiny of fore

items.h: Chandra hire D’Souza is Voltas chair; Trent MD joins board
items.p: The appointment puts one of Noel’s longest-held board positions in the hands of an executive hired by Tata Sons chairman N. Chandrasekaran, who chairs Tata Consumer, and is Noel's rival in a deepening leadership tussle within the group.

items.h: IDBI Bank stake sale: ‘Very, very remote’ chance of finding another buyer at  ₹52,000 crore, says DIPAM Secretary Chawla
items.p: After weighing cancellation, accepting the existing offer and seeking revised bids, the Core Group of Secretaries on Disinvestment chose to invite improved offers for IDBI Bank to maximise the transaction value, DIPAM Secretary Arunish Chawla said.

items.h: Honasa Consumer eyes hair colour entry as Q2 net profit jumps 87% to  ₹73 crore
items.p: Focus categories, including face cleansers, shampoos, face serums, suncare and moisturisers, grew over 40% during the quarter and accounted for more than 80% of its business.

items.h: Who is Kishore Biyani? CBI books Future Retail founder, brother in alleged  ₹904-crore SBI loan fraud case
items.p: The CBI has booked Future Retail founder Kishore Biyani and his brother Rakesh in an alleged  ₹904.32-crore bank fraud case following an SBI complaint. The agency searched premises linked to Biyani in Mumbai, alleging loan fund diversion through associate companies.

items.h: Delhi High Court upholds BharatPe’s veto rights in Unity SFB capital raise dispute
items.p: The court dismissed Unity SFB's appeal, ruling that the joint venture bank cannot alter its capital structure or dilute BharatPe’s 49% stake without its prior consent.

items.h: GIC Re’s NSE windfall masks weaker Q2 as flood claims, health push weigh
items.p: The gain from the offer-for-sale in NSE’s IPO helped lift GIC Re’s investment income by11.8% to  ₹4,238.26 crore

items.h: Airtel brings back  ₹299 plan on churn concerns
items.p: The move comes after the telecom operator saw a sharp slowdown in subscriber additions and a higher customer churn in the September quarter, underscoring the challenge of raising tariffs in India's price-sensitive mobile market when rivals stay put.

items.h: Hindalco beats Q2 estimates as strong metal prices offset rising input costs
items.p: The company reported an almost 59% jump in consolidated net profit to  ₹7,532 crore in Q2, but a 39% rise in input costs during the quarter threatens to squeeze near-term margins.

items.h: Delhi HC issues notice to Red Bull on food regulator's review plea
items.p: Red Bull's matter has been listed for a hearing in January, along with petitions filed by other beverage companies, including PepsiCo India, Reliance Consumer, and Monster Energy India, challenging FSSAI’s action against the use of energy drink description.

items.h: Who is Venugopal Dhoot? Former Videocon promoter declared ‘bankrupt’ by NCLT Mumbai bench over  ₹12,668-cr SBI default
items.p: The NCLT Mumbai bench declared former Videocon Industries promoter Venugopal Dhoot ‘bankrupt’ after accepting SBI’s petition over loan defaults of  ₹12,668 crore. A bankruptcy trustee will administer the proceedings.

items.h: US-Iran war: HPCL struggles to secure tankers to transport oil from the Strait of Hormuz | Here's what the chairman said
items.p: Hindustan Petroleum Corp is facing difficulties securing tankers to transport crude oil. Limited vessel availability and last-minute cancellations continue to disrupt shipping arrangements amid rising oil flows from the region.

items.h: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang loses $15 billion as AI-linked stock sell-off knocks him down to 13th on billionaire list
items.p: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang lost $15.1 billion as AI-linked stocks tumbled after Democrats’ midterm victories. The sell-off dragged down major technology shares, wiping out $2.5 trillion from the US stock market on Thursday.

items.h: Who is Jasleen Kaur? Bata India's new Marketing Head is IIT Delhi graduate, Columbia alumna and published poet
items.p: Jasleen Kaur G is the new Head of Marketing at Bata India Limited. Here's all you need to know about her career and education.

items.h: Noel Tata to step down as Titan vice-chairman and director on 12 November as he turns 70
items.p: Noel Tata's exit from several Tata Group boards comes amid a dispute with Tata Sons over N Chandrasekaran's reappointment and the proposed listing of the holding company. He will, however, remain a Tata Trusts nominee director on Tata Sons' board.

items.h: Anthropic's 'largest IPO on record' ambition on hold? 'AI backlash could threaten timing, $1.5 trillion valuation'
items.p: Anthropic IPO: Three major investors who plan to take part in the offering told a US media outlet that the valuation would likely need to be lowered, with one saying it could end up closer to $1 trillion.

items.h: Musk's $470 million political bet: Why Tesla, SpaceX's Texas expansion faces a regulatory test after US midterms
items.p: Elon Musk's $470 million bet on Republicans has raised questions over Tesla and SpaceX's Texas expansion after Democrats won the US midterms. Investors fear tighter data-centre regulations could delay projects, increase costs and complicate a potential merger.

items.h: Tata Motors finds task cut out for Iveco turnaround after twin losses
items.p: Iveco lost €45 million in the September quarter, its second quarterly loss this year, just as Tata Motors took control. Tata must now turn it around while carrying acquisition debt and honouring conditions that block immediate restructuring.

items.h: PE firms turn to management incentives to drive growth and unlock exit value
items.p: Management incentives, paid over and above the pay package, can be seen as profit sharing and help private equity (PE) funds attract and retain top talent to lead portfolio companies through to exit, industry executives said.

items.h: Hertz Shares Plunge as Car Renter Warns It’s Running Low on Cash
items.p: Hertz Global Holdings Inc. shares plummeted after the car renter cautioned it expects to end the year with less cash and borrowing capacity than previously expected.

items.h: KFC launches themed menu and more as it teams up with Marvel's Doctor Doom for Avengers Doomsday campaign worldwide
items.p: KFC to team up with Marvel in its most expansive collaboration to date. Check when and where it will be available.

items.h: Anthropic is rapidly accelerating AI development amid slowdown calls, outside research group says
items.p: Anthropic is rapidly accelerating AI development amid slowdown calls, outside research group says

items.h: Who is Herjit Singh Bhalla? Dabur India appoints CEO as Whole-time Director for a five-year term from November 14
items.p: Dabur India has appointed India business CEO Herjit Singh Bhalla as an additional and whole-time director for five years from November 14, subject to regulatory clearances. Global CEO Mohit Malhotra will step down on November 13, 2026, after nearly three decades with the company.

items.h: Jio launches voice-only plans from  ₹147: How do prices compare with Airtel and Vi?
items.p: Jio's voice-only prepaid offerings start at  ₹147, which comes with a validity of 22 days. At the higher end, the company offers a  ₹1,748 plan with a validity of 336 days.

items.h: Revolut confirms $115 billion valuation after latest share sale, up from $75 billion in less than a year
items.p: The secondary share sale, which began in July, allowed existing investors, including employees, to sell their holdings to other investors. The transaction did not involve the issuance of new shares by Revolut.

items.h: Titan misses Q2 revenue estimates but beats profit view as jewellery demand holds up
items.p: Demand for gold coins and investment products remains subdued, even as Titan sees stronger traction in lower-caratage jewellery and 24% growth in its jewellery portfolio.

items.h: SRTT tells charity commissioner its order ‘tied hands’ on Mehli reply
items.p: In filings before Maharashtra’s charity commissioner, former Tata Trusts trustee Mehli Mistry questioned Venu Srinivasan’s vote after his trustee tenure expired and challenged Noel Tata’s eligibility to serve on a charitable trust.

items.h: PhysicsWallah Q2 net profit more than doubles to nearly  ₹144 crore as revenue rises 18%
items.p: PhysicsWallah Q2 net profit more than doubles to  ₹143.63 crore as revenue rises 18%, driven by online growth and higher NEET enrolments.

items.h: Berger Paints misses Q2 profit estimates as raw material inflation squeezes margins
items.p: Berger Paints’ September-quarter profit rose 5% to  ₹216.88 crore, missing analyst estimates as raw-material costs surged faster than prices. Revenue grew 13.2%, while gross margins narrowed.

items.h: Who is Cat Wu? Claude Code product chief joins OpenAI days after quitting Anthropic
items.p: OpenAI hires Anthropic’s Catherine Wu, who helped turn Claude Code into a commercial success, as it steps up competition in AI coding.

items.h: Flipkart delivering late amid festive season? Irked customers cancel orders, flag delay in iPhone 17 shipment
items.p: Flipkart customers have complained on social media about alleged delayed deliveries, repeatedly changing arrival dates, cancelled orders and deductions from refunds during the festive shopping season. The complaints include an iPhone 17 order delayed beyond its promised date.&nbs

items.h: Adani Ports to enter Europe with €2.56 billion buyout of Evos
items.p: The company will pay €1.18 billion in cash to buy 100% of Evos over 15 months, sealing its biggest buyout to date by enterprise value.

items.h: Govt sets up high-level banking panel under Suresh N. Patel
items.p: The panel will review India's banking sector and recommend structural, institutional, regulatory and legislative reforms to make it globally competitive, financially inclusive and resilient by 2047.

items.h: Extreme poverty in India falls to 2.6% from 27.1%: World Bank
items.p: As many as 496 million people moved above the lower-middle-income poverty line of $4.20 a day between 2011 and 2023, according to the World Bank’s October 2026 Poverty & Equity Brief.

items.h: ‘2026 resembles 1991’: Why CEA V Anantha Nageswaran wants India to rethink its growth strategy — what he said
items.p: India must rethink its growth strategy as global tensions and supply-chain shocks threaten access to critical resources, Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran warned. He urged stronger domestic capabilities, diversified imports and strategic buffers.

items.h: Gold Vs Real Estate: गोल्ड या रियल एस्टेट, इनवेस्टमेंट के लिए कौन सही है?
items.p: गोल्ड बहुत लिक्विड है। इसका मतलब यह है कि जरूरत पड़ने पर आप इसे बेचकर पैसा हासिल कर सकते हैं। मुसीबत के वक्त यह बहुत काम आता है। अब तो गोल्ड लोन कंपनियां सोना पर लोन भी दे रही हैं

items.h: मोतीलाल ओसवाल म्यूचुअल फंड ने तीन इंटरनेशनल स्कीम्स में SIPs को रोका, क्या आप भी कर रहे हैं इसमें निवेश
items.p: विदेशी निवेश जोखिम पर लिमिटेशन के कारण एसेट मैनेजमेंट कंपनी ने ये निर्णय लिया है

items.h: EPFO Is Best: चार दशक में सबसे कम इंट्रेस्ट के बावजूद EPF बेस्ट है, जानिए कैसे
items.p: ईपीएफओ के सब्सक्राइबर्स के लिए बेसिक सैलरी का 12 फीसदी कंट्रिब्यूशन अनिवार्य है। आपके पास इसके लिए किसी तरह का चॉइस नहीं है। हर महीने यह पैसा अपने पास आपकी सैलरी से कट जाता है

items.h: Paytm Share Update: स्टॉक्स में तेज गिरावट पर Paytm ने BSE को दिया जवाब
items.p: पेटीएम ने बीएसई को बताया है कि उसका बिजनेस पूरी तरह से मजबूत है। उसने यह भी कहा है कि समय-समय पर वह सभी जरूरी जानकारियां तय समय के अंदर बीएसई को देती रही है

items.h: Reliance Retail ने लॉन्जरी रिटेलर Clovia में 950 करोड़ रुपये में खरीदी 89% हिस्सेदारी
items.p: Clovia को पंकज वर्मानी, नेहा कांत और सुमन चौधरी द्वारा 2013 में लॉन्च किया गया था

items.h: शानदार रिटर्न कमाना चाहते हैं? अगली होली तक आपको मालामाल कर देंगे ये 5 शेयर
items.p: पिछली होली से इस होली (18 नवंबर, 2022) के बीच स्टॉक मार्केट्स ने 19 फीसदी रिटर्न दिया है। इस दौरान मार्केट में काफी उतार-चढ़ाव रहा। अक्टूबर में मार्केट ऑल-टाइम हाई पर पहुंचा। फिर, उसमें 7.5 फीसदी गिरावट आई

items.h: LIC के आईपीओ में इनवेस्ट करना चाहते हैं? पेटीएम और जोमैटो के आईपीओ से ये सबक ले सकते हैं
items.p: ज्यादातर इनवेस्टर्स को यह पता नहीं होता कि वे किसी आईपीओ में पैसा क्यों लगा रहे हैं। इनवेस्टमेंट गोल (लक्ष्य) और एग्जिट स्ट्रेटेजी के बगैर किसी आईपीओ में इनवेस्ट करना सही नहीं है

items.h: सरकारी स्कीम में 1500 रुपये निवेश कर मिलेंगे 35 लाख रुपये, मिलता है गारंटी रिटर्न
items.p: Post Office Scheme: फाइनेंशियल मार्केट में निवेश ऑप्शन्स हैं जिनमें रिटर्न भी काफी अच्छा मिलता है

items.h: Paytm Share Updates: एनालिस्ट ने पेटीएम शेयर का टारगेट प्राइस घटाया, जानिए कितना हो जाएगा इसका भाव
items.p: लिस्टिंग के बाद से पेटीएम का शेयर 71 फीसदी से ज्यादा गिर चुका है। पिछले साल नवंबर में यह शेयर स्टॉक मार्केट में लिस्ट हुआ था

items.h: क्या आप जोमैटो, पेटीएम, पॉलिसीबाजार के आईपीओ में निवेश का मौका चूक गए? बहुत सस्ते भाव पर मिल रहे ये शेयर
items.p: जौमेटो, पेटीएम, कारट्रेड और पॉलिसीबाजार के शेयर अभी बहुत कम भाव पर मिल रहे हैं। इन कंपनियों के शेयर प्राइस इश्यू प्राइस से बहुत नीचे आ गए हैं

items.h: Tax Reforms: बदल जाएंगे कैपिटल गेंस टैक्स के नियम, जानिए अभी शेयर इनकम पर कितना लगता है
items.p: कैपिटल गेंस टैक्स स्ट्रक्चर में बदलाव के लिए कानून में संशोधन की जरूरत पड़ेगी। इसलिए सरकार अगले बजट में इस प्रस्ताव को पेश करना चाहती है

items.h: Tax Planning: NPS में इनवेस्ट कर आप बचा सकते हैं काफी टैक्स, जानिए कैसे
items.p: यूनियन बजट 2015 में 80सीसीडी में एक और अमेंडमेंट किया गया। इसे सब सेक्शन (1बी) कहा गया। इसके तहत कोई व्यक्ति अतिरिक्त 50,000 रुपये का अतिरिक्त डिडक्शन क्लेम कर सकता है। यह सैलरीड और सेल्फ-इंप्लॉयड दोनों के लिए हैं
